related_questions.question: What is required to reenter the US from Canada?

text_blocks.snippet: To re-enter the U.S. from Canada, U.S. citizens generally need a valid U.S. passport or other approved travel document. Canadian citizens typically need a valid passport, and depending on their visa status, potentially an I-20 or DS-2019 form with a valid travel signature.
snippet_highlighted_words: a valid U.S. passport or other approved travel document

list.title: Passport:
list.snippet: A valid U.S. passport book or a passport card is generally required for air travel.

list.title: Other Approved Documents:
list.snippet: U.S. citizens may also be able to use other approved travel documents, such as those issued under the Western Hemisphere Travel Initiative (WHTI), according to the U.S. Department of State.

list.title: Passport:
list.snippet: Canadian citizens need a valid passport when entering the U.S., even when traveling by land or sea.

list.title: I-20 or DS-2019:
list.snippet: If you are a student on an F-1 or J-1 visa, you need your valid I-20 or DS-2019 form, respectively, with a travel signature from your Designated School Official (DSO) or Responsible Officer (RO), according to UC Santa Barbara.

list.title: Visa:
list.snippet: Canadian citizens generally don't need a visa to enter the U.S. for tourism or business, but there are exceptions.

list.title: Expiration Dates:
list.snippet: Ensure your passport and other required documents are valid and won't expire during your trip.

list.title: I-94:
list.snippet: Canadian citizens may need to obtain an I-94 form upon arrival, which indicates their authorized period of stay.

list.title: Financial Documents:
list.snippet: Students on F-1 or J-1 visas may need to show proof of sufficient financial resources.

list.title: Travel Signature:
list.snippet: For students on F-1 or J-1 visas, the travel signature on the I-20 or DS-2019 must be recent (typically within the last year, but potentially within the last 6 months for OPT/STEM OPT).

list.title: Visa Waiver Program:
list.snippet: If you are not a Canadian citizen, you may need a visa or ESTA (Electronic System for Travel Authorization) to enter the U.S., depending on your nationality.

text_blocks.snippet: To enter the United States, most foreign citizens need a valid passport and a visa, or must be eligible for the Visa Waiver Program. The specific requirements depend on the traveler's nationality and the purpose of their visit.
snippet_highlighted_words: a valid passport and a visa, or must be eligible for the Visa Waiver Program

list.title: Passport:
list.snippet: A valid passport is generally required for all travelers to the US, and it should be valid for at least six months beyond your intended stay.

list.title: Visa (if needed):
list.snippet: Most travelers, unless they are from a Visa Waiver Program country or have another exception, will need to obtain a visa before traveling to the US.

list.title: Visa Waiver Program:
list.snippet: Citizens of certain countries can enter the US for tourism or business for up to 90 days without a visa, provided they meet the requirements of the program.

list.title: Other Documents:
list.snippet: Depending on the purpose of the visit and the traveler's circumstances, additional documents like a Nonimmigrant Visa Application (DS-160) or a valid entry document (like a Green Card) may be required.
Nonimmigrant Visas: For temporary stays, such as for tourism, work, or study.
Immigrant Visas: For those seeking to live permanently in the US.
Citizens of VWP countries can travel to the US for tourism or business (generally for 90 days or less) without a visa.
They must have a valid passport that meets the requirements of the program.
They must also apply for authorization through the Electronic System for Travel Authorization (ESTA).

list.title: Purpose of Visit:
list.snippet: The type of visa or entry document needed depends on why you are traveling to the US.

list.title: Country of Citizenship:
list.snippet: The specific requirements for entry can vary depending on your nationality.

list.title: Travel Documents:
list.snippet: It's essential to carry all necessary travel documents with you, including your passport, visa (if needed), and any other relevant documents.

ESTA (.gov) is the official website for applying for ESTA authorization.
